# `nlink-lab link add`

## Reference

<!-- cli-ref:start (generated by `nlink-lab docs-gen`; do not edit) -->

```text
Add a veth link: `link add r1:eth2 r2:eth2 10.9.0.1/30 10.9.0.2/30` (the addresses are optional, both or none)

Usage: nlink-lab link add [OPTIONS] <A> <B> [ADDR_A] [ADDR_B]...

Arguments:
  <A>
          

  <B>
          

  [ADDR_A] [ADDR_B]...
          A's address and B's (CIDR)

Options:
  -L, --lab <LAB>
          The lab. Default: `$NLINK_LAB`, then the one `nlink-lab use` selected, then the only running lab

      --dry-run
          Show the plan; change nothing

  -h, --help
          Print help
```
